title: Refuse a dashboard widget dataset binding that names nothing at publish (#7529)
body:
Fixes #7529

## What

A dashboard widget could declare a dataset binding that names nothing and the metadata door answered 200 on both save and publish; referential integrity surfaced only as a runtime error on the live board. This PR gates dashboard writes with the existing `validateWidgetBindings` rule at the runtime publish door.

Root cause (dev report 5299565026, re-confirmed here on `origin/main` @ 15283cf): there is no missing validator — `validateWidgetBindings` implements `widget-dataset-unknown` at severity error and provably catches this exact body. It was registered `surfaces: CLI_ONLY`, and `dashboard` was not a runtime-gated type, so `runRuntimeAuthoringRules` returned empty before building a snapshot.

## Rulings implemented (not re-litigated)

- **2026-08-12** (comment 5271013412, option B): allow at save, refuse at publish with the offending key path named. A draft may hold a forward reference to a dataset not yet authored; the draft-to-active promotion runs the gate.
- **2026-08-15** (comment 5299950099): `surfaces` is registered per-rule, so the flip enforces all **six** of the rule's error ids as one "this board cannot render" reference-integrity class: `widget-dataset-unknown`, `widget-dimension-unknown`, `widget-measure-unknown`, `chart-field-unknown`, `widget-legacy-analytics-unrenderable`, `dashboard-filter-field-unknown`. The ~6x wider accept-set narrowing was accepted knowingly; the dataset limb was deliberately NOT split into its own rule, and no per-finding-id surface filter was added.
- PM discretion ratified in the same ruling: implement the narrow dashboard/datasets slice now, with #7529 to be recorded as a sub-issue of #4716 for bookkeeping. That parent link is NOT yet minted — the sub-issue API needs the issue's numeric database id, which no surface available to this dev session exposes; it is handed back to the PM as a one-call step in the dev report.

Measured delta vs the ruling's list: the rule today also carries `dashboard-filter-field-unprovisioned` (#8340), severity **warning** — it rides the non-blocking `advisories` channel with the other warning-tier ids (`table-count-only`, `chart-config-missing`, `widget-legacy-analytics-shape`, `measure-aggregate-incoherent`), so the blocking accept-set is exactly the six error ids the ruling names. The ruling's premise holds unchanged.

## How

- `packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts` — the `validateWidgetBindings` entry flips to `CLI_AND_RUNTIME` with `runtimeTypes: ['dashboard']`; its `surfaceReason` is dropped.
- `packages/lint/src/runtime-gate.ts` — `RuntimeStackContext` gains `datasets`; `CONTEXT_STACK_KEYS` carries it in both differential passes. Load-bearing, not optional: without it a fully legitimate 3-widget board produces 3 phantom `widget-dataset-unknown` errors through the gate's own differential (pinned as a test), the same false-422 shape as #8309's 38-vs-4 measurement.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` — `listCollection('dataset', 'datasets')` gathered per write beside objects/permissions/books, re-located by symbol (the file is hot; report line numbers were stale).
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/runtime-authoring-gate.ts` — `evaluateRuntimeAuthoringGate` accepts and forwards `datasets`. **File-surface delta, flagged not silent**: the dispatch named `protocol.ts` as the only metadata-protocol file, but the thread-through cannot compile without widening this intermediary's argument type — one doc-commented arg key plus one forwarding line, same package, part of the same ~3-line thread-through the dispatch described.

## Patch round (CI at ff4e3be): one consumer fixture re-judged

`Test Core (2/3)` failed at `ff4e3be`: `packages/objectql/src/protocol-meta.test.ts` — "accepts a spec-conformant dashboard payload". **Attribution: this PR, mechanically certain** — the refusal is thrown by the exact rule flip this change makes (the serialized error carries `rulesRun: ['validateWidgetBindings']`, which is empty-by-construction for `dashboard` on main, where objectql CI is green). No clean-base run was needed to settle direction: the test passes on main because the gate does not run there.

The fixture saved an ACTIVE dashboard whose widget binds `opportunity_metrics` over a registry that declares **no datasets** — a dangling binding. Its old acceptance was precisely the card's symptom (200 on a reference that resolves to nothing), so making it green by weakening the gate would re-open the card. The test's intent — "a spec-conformant dashboard payload is accepted" — is preserved by making the fixture genuinely valid in the ruled sense: the dataset the widget binds is now registered (`registry.registerItem('dataset', …)`, with measure `amount_sum` so the widget's `values` selection resolves too). Fixture-triage disposition: **re-spell**, not replace — the acceptance claim survives; only the referential coherence the ruling now demands was added.

Consumer-radius sweep at the same time (repo-wide grep for widget-bearing dashboard fixtures in tests): the other objectql dashboard fixtures (`build-probes`, `overlay-precedence`, `protocol-publish-rollback`) measured green in the full suite run; `packages/rest/src/rest.test.ts` uses dashboards only on the READ path over a mocked protocol (gate never runs); spec tests are schema-only; the dogfood roundtrip binds a real showcase dataset. `protocol-meta.test.ts` was the sole casualty.

`origin/main` was merged (`34bb529`) before the re-push so CI computes against current main.

## Accept-set delta, scoped

The rule is `tier: gating, commands: ALL`, so config-authored stacks already fail `os validate` / `os build` / `os lint` on these six ids. The newly refused population is exactly the door the CLI cannot see: `sys_metadata` overlay publishes through Studio / REST `/meta` / MCP. Stored rows are untouched (the gate blocks new publishes only, #4463 D4) and `OS_ALLOW_UNLINTED_METADATA_WRITES=1` remains the migration hatch.

## Changeset

`minor` for `@objectstack/lint` and `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`: this narrows the accept set of a published authoring surface and widens two public signatures (`RuntimeStackContext.datasets`, `evaluateRuntimeAuthoringGate` args) — behavioral narrowing plus additive API, no removal or rename, and `check-changeset-no-major` refuses `major` by policy. Not declared-breaking, so no ADR-0087 marker is required (`check-adr-0087-registration` green).

## Tests

Union re-run at `bac10dc` (clean tree, after the final commit — the patch-round head, `origin/main` merged):

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql test` — 210 files, **3675 tests green** (the consumer suite the first union missed; includes the re-spelled fixture).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint test` — 72 files, **2039 tests green**. #7529 block in `runtime-gate.test.ts`: dispatch pin; the card's body refused with the path named; 0-phantom legitimate board; the load-bearing 3-phantom ablation of the `datasets` context key (reverse verification in its inverted direction — MORE errors without the fix); all six error ids reachable at the door with exact per-case error sets; warnings on the advisory channel; D4 dataset-level cancellation; gate-vs-CLI verdict parity corpus.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol test` — 103 files, **1493 tests green**. `protocol.dashboard-dataset-publish-gate.test.ts`: ADR-0112 envelope (`code` AND `status`) on an active save of the dangling board; draft forward-reference allowed; draft-to-active promotion gated; a legitimate 3-widget board publishes through the real `saveMetaItem` (the discriminating test for the thread-through); the forward-reference-then-dataset-appears-then-publish workflow.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint typecheck` green. `metadata-protocol` has no `typecheck` script (DEBT-ledgered); its tsup DTS build compiles the source — green.
- Gates at `bac10dc`, judged by exit status, all 0: `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:durability-log-level`, `check:filter-alias-parity`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:query-options-erasure`, `check:type-check-coverage`, `check:type-check-debt` (full packages turbo build + re-measure, per lint.yml), `check:changeset-gate-self-tests`, `check:objectui-changeset`, `check:engine-double-contract`, `node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs`, `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`, `node scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs`, `node scripts/check-cross-package-test-inputs.mjs`. The fake engine in the new protocol test copies the pinned harness verbatim, `assertEngineDeleteDispatch` / `assertEngineUpdateDispatch` included.
  - `check:type-check-debt` prints the same informational surplus as before the patch round (lint TEST_DEBT records 20, measures 19) — an optional-lowering invitation per its own text (#4311 / #6376), unchanged by this PR; left to the ledger's own `--lower` flow.
